function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the complete public-evidence attribution chain involving the Guccifer 2.0 and DCLeaks personas and alleged GRU-controlled election-interference operations. Use only evidence available through the benchmark tools and report the exact source IDs returned by those tools; do not invent or supplement source details. Prioritize public indictments and incident-response or forensic findings, but include other benchmark-returned primary or authoritative materials when needed. Determine: (1) what each source explicitly says about the identity or operators alleged to be behind Guccifer 2.0 and DCLeaks; (2) whether and how the two personas are linked to each other; (3) technical, behavioral, operational, or documentary evidence linking either persona to GRU-controlled activity; (4) what public indictment evidence alleges versus what it proves or merely asserts; (5) what incident-response evidence independently corroborates, qualifies, contradicts, or does not address the indictment narrative; (6) alternative explanations and unresolved uncertainty. Distinguish verified facts, allegations, intelligence assessments, attribution judgments, and evidentiary limitations. For every proposition, provide exact benchmark source IDs and quote or closely summarize only what those sources support. Return a structured evidence matrix with entities, explicitly supported relationships, source IDs, contradictions, and a cautious synthesis suitable for a final report. Do not use acronyms or abbreviations in place of full terms unless the source itself requires them."}
function.name: ConductResearch
